description: Hand SEVERAL tasks to other agents as ONE group, with dependencies (fan-out/fan-in). teile: [{schluessel, to_agent_id, message, nach?: [schluessel…]}]. A part with `nach` waits (status wartend) until all named parts are done, then starts with their results appended to its message ("Ergebnisse der Vorgaenger: …"). If a predecessor fails, the dependent part fails with the reason and never starts. When every part is finished, the results are merged ONCE into {antwort (max 4 sentences), offen[], widersprueche[]} and returned as ONE result: wait_for_result=true resumes THIS session with it (Dev-Agent session); a group started during a WhatsApp turn sends ONE WhatsApp message. Receivers report with report_task_result. Limits per order (tenant settings): depth, number of handoffs, tokens; a handoff back to an agent earlier in the same chain is refused. Use get_delegation_group to look at the state. Tell the person 'handed over', never 'done', until the merged result is there.

auftrag.description: The overall order in one or two sentences — used when merging the results.

from_agent_id.description: Sending agent; default: the acting agent.

session_name.description: Name der Sitzung, die mit dem zusammengefassten Ergebnis fortgesetzt wird

teile.description: Teilaufgaben: [{schluessel, to_agent_id, message, nach?}] mit optionalen Abhaengigkeiten

message.description: Everything the receiver needs for this part.

nach.description: Keys of parts that must be done first.

schluessel.description: Short key of this part, unique in the group (letters, digits, _ . -), e.g. "daten", "plan", "offerte".

wait_for_result.description: Resume this session with the merged result of the group.

name: delegate_tasks
